nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Agent instructions for the diff-wasm package, codifying the WASM fallback retry pattern (a permanent `wasmFailed` flag so failed imports skip straight to the JS fallback instead of resetting `wasmReady`) and the `as unknown as` type-cast convention used at the `formatPatch`/`applyPatch` boundaries with the `diff` library.
nodes.languageNotes: Illustrates the memoized-promise-with-permanent-failure-flag idiom: caching the rejected `wasmReady` promise prevents re-attempting a failed dynamic WASM import on every call.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Rust crate manifest for `opencode-diff-rs` (the WASM diff engine behind the package), declaring dual `cdylib`/`rlib` crate types and the `similar`, `wasm-bindgen`, `serde`, and `serde-wasm-bindgen` dependencies used by the wasm-pack web build of `src/lib.rs`.
nodes.languageNotes: crate-type = ["cdylib", "rlib"] lets the same crate compile to a loadable WASM module for wasm-pack and a plain Rust library for native builds and tests.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for `@opencode-ai/diff-wasm`, exposing `src/index.ts` directly as main/module/types entry, and providing the `build:wasm` wasm-pack script that generates the gitignored `pkg/` artifacts the bridge imports at runtime.
nodes.languageNotes: Exports raw `.ts` source (no build step) so workspace consumers resolve the live file, while the compiled output lives entirely in the gitignored `pkg/` directory.
